svg.title: Lutron systems map
svg.desc: Layered diagram of Lutron clouds and clients, processors, coprocessors, radio links (CCA 433 MHz, CCX Thread 2.4 GHz, BLE, QS Link RS-485) and end devices, with the openlutron transceiver and host tooling that tap into them.
svg.text: Lutron control stack: what this repo has mapped
Cloud, processors, coprocessors, radios and end devices, with the pathways found so far. Highlighted blocks are ours.
SmartBridge: stateless, UART IPC to AM335x
REP2 / Pro: STM32L100, EFR32 images too
key from LEAP or Designer DB
CCA · Clear Connect Type A · 433 MHz
same frames as wired QS Link
Per-processor channel; picos need manual re-channel
protocol/*.ts: one source, codegen to C
firmware RE: Ghidra / Binary Ninja / BDM
CCX to WiZ bridge, HA add-on, WiZ bulbs
